# Parser corpus fixtures.
#
# Format: <fixture>.ll | <upstream citation> | <option>...
#
# Options:
#   status=pass         upstream's RUN line accepts it: must parse, verify, and
#                       print/re-parse/print to the same bytes twice.
#   status=reject       upstream runs `not llvm-as` / `not opt` over it: the
#                       parse must fail.
#   status=xfail-parse  llvmkit gap: upstream accepts it, llvmkit does not parse
#                       it yet.
#   status=xfail-verify llvmkit gap: parses, but does not verify.
#   error=<text>        `reject` only. Upstream's FileCheck diagnostic text; the
#                       rendered message must contain it, FileCheck's own rule.
#   loc=<line>:<col>    `reject` only. Upstream's `<stdin>:LINE:COL:` pin.
#   expect=<fixture>    golden print to compare against.
#
# The two xfail statuses have no rows: `grep 'status=xfail' ` over this file
# matches only the two option lines above. A fixture llvmkit cannot handle is
# classified `blocked-model` in docs/fixture-coverage.md and gets no row here
# at all, so an xfail row is a state the driver can express and the corpus does
# not currently occupy. The three rows that used to carry `xfail-parse` were
# upstream *negatives*, not llvmkit gaps, and are `reject` rows now with their
# diagnostic pinned.
#
# Fixtures under upstream/assembler-corpus/ are byte-for-byte copies of
# llvm/test/Assembler/*.ll. A row citing `split-file part <p>` is the exact
# split-file output for one part of a multi-part container -- the text
# upstream's own RUN line hands to llvm-as.
facade_minimal.ll | unittests/AsmParser/AsmParserTest.cpp::TEST(AsmParserTest, ParseAssemblyString) | status=pass
corpus_flags_minimal.ll | test/Assembler/flags.ll | expect=corpus_flags_minimal.expected.ll | status=pass
corpus_dbg_declare_value.ll | test/Assembler/dbg_declare_value.ll | expect=corpus_dbg_declare_value.expected.ll | status=pass
corpus_dbg_record_after_terminator_invalid.ll | test/Assembler/dbg-record-invalid-0.ll | status=reject | loc=6:1 | error=expected instruction opcode
upstream/vscale-round-trip.ll | test/Bitcode/vscale-round-trip.ll (whole file) | status=pass

# `blockaddress-addrspace.ll`'s three split-file parts. `return_self_bad.ll`
# is the negative one; its own `; CHECK` line carries the `[[#@LINE-1]]:24:`
# pin this row reproduces.
upstream/blockaddress-addrspace/return_self_good.ll | test/Bitcode/blockaddress-addrspace.ll::return-self-good.ll | status=pass
upstream/blockaddress-addrspace/return_self_bad.ll | test/Bitcode/blockaddress-addrspace.ll::return-self-bad.ll | status=reject | loc=8:24 | error=constant expression type mismatch: got type 'ptr addrspace(1)' but expected 'ptr addrspace(2)'
upstream/blockaddress-addrspace/global_fwddecl_good.ll | test/Bitcode/blockaddress-addrspace.ll::global-fwddecl-good.ll | status=pass
upstream/pr119818.ll | test/Assembler/pr119818.ll | status=pass
upstream/2010-02-05-FunctionLocalMetadataBecomesNull/global_forward_gep.ll | test/Assembler/2010-02-05-FunctionLocalMetadataBecomesNull.ll global forward GEP excerpt | status=pass
